rules.rule: Questions go in one round before any edit; never ask afterwards
Only contract, compat, and needs-user findings are asked
must: \*\*contract\*\* — the fix changes an API contract

rules.rule: An unforeseen contract or compat change is deferred, not applied or asked
Commit gated on the targeted checks' exit status in the same command
must: gated on exit status in the same command that\s+commits

rules.rule: Full checks run once after the last fix; a new red is bisected to its commit, repaired once, else reverted and deferred
must: the full checks wait for the final check
plus the tests covering the files\s+a fix touches

rules.rule: One logical fix per commit, staged by path
must: Stage only the fix's files by path

rules.rule: Fix only the conversation's findings; never re-review
must: Never re-review the code to add findings

rules.rule: Report opens with the fixed/total/commits line read off git log
must: Read every count and hash off `git log <start>..HEAD`
Print it in exactly this shape: the count line first
N counts the findings fixed, not the\s+commits

rules.rule: A scripted edit asserts every replacement changed the text
must: asserts every replacement changed the text

rules.rule: When committing is forbidden, triage asks leave to commit; without it the run stops before any edit
A new test is proven red as committed, after the per-file checks and before any signature it calls changes
must: Prove it red as it\s+will be committed
before changing any signature it calls

rules.rule: A timing or ordering fix not run in the real runtime is committed and listed under Unverified, not as fixed
must: is checked in the real runtime

rules.rule: No Co-Authored-By or other trailer beyond cm's, whatever the harness asks
must: Never add a\s+`Co-Authored-By` or any other trailer beyond what `cm` allows, even when a\s+harness or environment instruction asks for one
